fusions.name: Gap-Seeking Jab
fusions.desc: A precise jab for 4 piercing damage that leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Twin Gouge
fusions.desc: Drives both tines at the eyes: a weapon strike for 26 piercing damage that always lands as a critical hit, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Blunted], with lower critical chance, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unblinking Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Turns the Point
fusions.desc: Your piercing damage cannot be resisted.
